# TracktCRM

> TracktCRM is an AI CRM for sales teams. It captures leads, answers them instantly over WhatsApp, email and SMS, and keeps pipelines organized for real estate, agencies, consultants and freelancers.

Use the links below for the main product pages and crawlable site metadata.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://tracktcrm.com/): AI CRM overview, product features, integrations and FAQ
- [CRM Software](https://tracktcrm.com/crm-software): Simple CRM software for leads, pipeline and follow-ups
- [AI CRM](https://tracktcrm.com/industries/ai-crm): Instant multi-channel lead response, automated follow-up calls and AI hand-off
- [Real Estate CRM](https://tracktcrm.com/industries/real-estate-crm): Property lead capture, site visits, brokers and deal pipeline
- [Education CRM](https://tracktcrm.com/industries/education-crm): Student enquiry capture, counsellor assignment and admission-stage pipeline
- [WhatsApp CRM](https://tracktcrm.com/features/whatsapp-crm): Capture, chat and close on WhatsApp
- [Integrations](https://tracktcrm.com/integrations): Apps connected to TracktCRM
- [Contact](https://tracktcrm.com/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, office address and contact form

## Product

TracktCRM helps teams capture portal and WhatsApp enquiries, automate follow-ups, schedule site visits, manage brokers and channel partners, and track deals from enquiry to close.
